title: No path is made relative across drives, in tests or tools
description: Second instance of the cross-drive relpath class (P132.5 fixed suite_elsewhere_paths; P133.1's gtf-block fixture reintroduced it), so the class is closed by a check, not another instance fix.
desiredOutcome: The release tier is green on Windows, and a relpath between a scratch directory (C:) and the checkout (D:) can no longer be written without a lint naming it.

tasks.title: Every relpath in tests/ and tools/ whose two sides can sit on different drives goes through one helper that never raises across drives, and a lint names any bare one
tasks.description: CI run 39746079909 (ci/P133 @c339c804): tests/test_run_test_gate.py gtf-block raises `ValueError: path is on mount 'D:', start on mount 'C:'` while building its cases (546/547) on windows plain 2, cp1252 2 and resample - the checkout is on D:, tempfile scratch on C:. P132.5 fixed the same thing in tools/lints/_output_lints.suite_elsewhere_paths. Find every os.path.relpath / posix_rel call in tests/ and tools/ (and plugins/audit/scripts if a call can see a scratch path), classify each (both sides inside one root by construction vs a side that can be a tempfile path), route the risky ones through one helper (in tests/_harness.py for suites, _output for shipped code if needed) that returns a usable answer across drives (the absolute path, or a stated refusal) instead of raising, and add a lint case (in tools/_suite.py, the home of the removal lint) that names a bare relpath between a tempfile/mkdtemp-derived path and a repo path. Emulate Windows with ntpath on posix to prove the red.

add: tools/_suite.py: a planted suite that relpaths a mkdtemp-derived path against a repo path is named by the new lint, and the same call through the helper is not; and ntpath.relpath across 'C:' and 'D:' is shown to raise while the helper returns an answer

request: Owner rule: CI after every phase; CI on ci/P133 (run 39746079909) red on Windows from a cross-drive relpath in a new test fixture - the same class P132.5 fixed in one place
